notes:
NEW BLUEPRINT COLLISION, and it is the reason blueprint-match is scored low. 90f739dcde96__3124.jpg is THE SAME DRAWING as the plain '2.5 cm Slant Pocket' option's illustration (1c5aed3c1ce4__3104), differing only in that the pocket line is overprinted in red. Red here marks WHERE the pocket sits, not that anything is coloured - so the drawing depicts the NON-STRIPE option exactly and neither confirms, sizes nor positions the contrast stripe. Everything about the stripe comes from catalog text alone.

NO CENTIMETRES WERE INVENTED: this drawing carries zero dimension callouts - no numbers, no leader lines, no ruler ticks - so any absolute figure would be an assumed real-world size multiplied by a pixel ratio. The '2.5 cm' in the label is unverifiable from the blueprint. Two independent ratio normalisations were used instead and they agree.

NOT measurable: absolute lip width of the stripe; whether the pocket is bagged or on-seam behind the opening; the far-side front pocket, which is only a short edge-on line in the drawing.

The stripe as rendered is a flat perfectly uniform hairline with no thickness or shadow, so it sits uncomfortably close to reading as a DRAWN LINE rather than cloth - which is the main reason construction scores 42.
